integrity: The facet formula, flag check, integer homology presentation, mod-two quotient, cycle census, and translation-orbit partition are all reconstructed by the included verifier from the published cyclic definition.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the labeled complex \(Q_{7,2}\) and simple edge cycles. It neither proves global 14-vertex minimality for flag Klein-bottle triangulations nor classifies longer or non-simple representatives.
title: Complete integral systolic spectrum of the weakly regular 14-vertex Klein bottle
